agreements: The narrow organism skeleton remains worth preserving in a newly hash-bound successor: sole public projection, immutable witnessed rows, audit-only DREAM proposals, one fallible blind same-model SELF_CHECK for each eligible new proposal, deterministic recurrent construction, target-absent THINK0, matched post-prefix OWN/DIST return branches, fresh atomic THINK1, prospective text-reader interventions, conditional two-adapter transport, monotone reviewed authority, and HUMAN_TERMINAL.

DREAM and SELF_CHECK are model calls rather than truth verifiers. SUPPORTED denotes model-claimed support under supplied public rows; structurally valid false self-approved rows remain eligible and may harm later behavior. No repair may add a semantic oracle, private-truth feedback, exact-answer verification, or outcome-selected corpus repair.

The exact v1d bytes are not one executable protocol. The illegal SELF_CHECK golden vector, incompatible witnessed identity domains, pre-stage-complete yet output-contingent SELF_CHECK registry, incomplete semantic matrix, unconditional terminal claims, and self-assertable review attestations require PROTOCOL_CONTRADICTION before implementation or dispatch.

P1CB02's substantive exact vectors do exist in the registered change and memory transport contract: goal_id, animal, source, target, and rendered question are independently mutated; every realized cue is tested against every other cue's roster; invalid substitutions are rejected before registry replacement; and the unchanged sealed valid state is byte-compared. The remaining R02 defect is acceptance-registry and semantic-matrix binding, not absence of the underlying vectors.

The v1d kind-discriminated row/query design and concrete semantic_hash/view_id/missing_index/cue-byte/cue-token roster identities substantively resolve R04. Those semantics must be retained and exhaustively bound; they do not cure the package-wide matrix omission.

P1CB06 supports only schedule executability and causal credit for the sixteen-slot goal-routed return intervention after a common 84-slot recurrent prefix. It does not ablate or establish necessity of prefix recurrence, repeated dreaming as a whole, graph growth as a whole, generic construction, or action improvement.

R07 is substantively resolved: SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE is VALID_STAGE_FAILURE, the other five text arms run, every T-SHAM opportunity has an exact zero-attempt row, and neither the full causal-use claim nor a weakened substitute is permitted.

The LoRA gate is immediate host-pre-resolved candidate-constrained recognition on training-derived resubstitution cues. The 48 cases per life are selected from twelve M1_OWN training rows and their four trained view families, with repeated training exposure and an answer-bearing roster; 44/48 is not an unseen-row, unseen-cue, preservation, recall, durability, capacity, scale, or generalization estimate.

A fully green text stage could support only realized dependence on the registered life-local text reader content for this exact aligned seed-5 twin pair, exact prompted game ontology, exact proof-sequence scaffold, and exact post-prefix return intervention, subject to the full M0/DIST/twin/path/sham/offline-correct structural-use conjunction. Public actions are environment-generated and the model commits only a final token, so action selection or improvement is not measured.

A fully green conditional LoRA stage could support only that each of exactly two isolated per-life adapters achieved at least 44/48 immediate candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognitions on its selected cues and supported the registered own/donor decision paths. It cannot establish text/LoRA equivalence, open or retrieval-free recall, whole-corpus storage or preservation, durability, capacity, scale, RAG/raw-context comparison, superiority, generalization, or the Paper-1 headline.

Any negative result localizes only to its registered stage and closed reason while preserving prompt, model, schedule, reducer, reader, runtime, fixture, optimization, and stochastic alternatives. One pair cannot establish a system-wide, substrate-wide, recurrence-wide, or Paper-1-wide negative conclusion.

Review evidence may establish only authentic platform-attested workflow separation for the exact lock, packet, roles, canonical actors, and fresh-context facts. Even an authenticated receipt does not prove substantive, human, model, ontological, or cryptographic independence of the reasoning; reviewer supremacy and changed-byte rereview remain mandatory.

The exact v1d change SHA must not be ratified, implemented, dispatched, fitted, run on GPU, or used for scientific promotion. Only a newly identified and newly hash-bound successor that satisfies every resolution below may begin a fresh interpretation, critique, consensus, and exact human-ratification chain.

resolution.rationale: The second position is compelled. A registry advertised as exhaustive cannot omit the direct edge that exposes the E/M conflict or omit P1CB02, P1CB03, P1CB04, P1CB05, and P1CB08. Hash equality binds conflicting bytes but does not reconcile them.

Terminal evidence must distinguish realized, not reached, infeasible, and failed facts, and authentic platform receipts must be verified against a closed issuer/trust interface and canonical actor identity.

An early CPU or DEV terminal cannot truthfully assert a realized seed-5 intervention or sham result, and an arbitrary 64-hex value is not an attestation. Authenticating workflow facts narrows operational uncertainty but still does not prove substantive independence.

resolution.required_change: The successor must add a closed terminal-claim-state schema covering HELDOUT_PAIR, MODEL_SUPPORTED_ROWS, READER_INTERVENTION, SHAM_CONTROL, and LORA_RESUBSTITUTION with exactly REALIZED, NOT_REACHED, INFEASIBLE, or FAILED plus applicable evidence hashes; define one exact vector and rendered wording template for every CPU, DEV, T, and L terminal reason; allow positive factual wording only for REALIZED; require SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE wording only for INFEASIBLE; and reject ambiguous keyword negation. Every terminal must still state its exact stage/reason, the game/proof scaffold, the lack of model-selected public actions or action-improvement evidence, the narrow negative localization, authenticated-platform-separation-only boundary, and HUMAN_TERMINAL. In addition, bind a genuine platform-owned external issuer lookup, a closed platform review-attestation receipt schema, and a hash-bound verifier/trust manifest; no repository-authored actor, implementation, test, or locally generated key may act as the issuer or trust root. Each lookup and signed receipt must bind the pinned platform issuer and key/version, canonical_actor_id, roles on the reviewed lock, reviewed_lock_sha256, review_packet_sha256, supplied_context_manifest_sha256, prior_turn_count=0, unlisted_context_received=false, issue time, and unique nonce; its RFC8785-JCS payload must carry a verifiable issuer signature against the platform trust root. Assignments and dispositions must reference the verified receipt and compare canonical_actor_id bytes, not caller-supplied display strings. Missing issuer capability, malformed, untrusted, bad-signature, stale, replayed, field-mismatched, or role-overlap receipts fail INVALID_PRECONDITION before transition. Reports must say only that these exact workflow facts were authenticated as platform attestations, never that reviewer reasoning or human/model independence was proved. Because no qualifying issuer exists in the v1d repository, the successor cannot claim this closure until that external interface is concretely named, bound, and tested.
